description: List messages in an aozora conversation — newest page first when before is omitted; pass before=cursor from a prior response to page backward (older). Same before/cursor/hasMore semantics as getConvo.

before.description: Cursor: the rkey of the oldest message already loaded client-side. Fetches the next (older) page.

cursor.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next older page. Absent when there's nothing older left.
